thesis: Drop of Honey removes the creature with the lowest power each upkeep without targeting, turning an empty or carefully managed battlefield into a slow green sweeper.

canonicalIdentity.currentOracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, destroy the creature with the least power. It can't be regenerated. If two or more creatures are tied for least power, you choose one of them. When there are no creatures on the battlefield, sacrifice this enchantment.

claims.summary: Arabian Nights 1993-12-17, credited artist Anson Maddocks.

At its controller's upkeep the creature with least power is destroyed without regeneration; if the least-power creatures tie, the controller chooses one during resolution. It does not target. Once there are no creatures on the battlefield it must be sacrificed. If Kird Ape and Savannah Lions each have two power, Drop's controller chooses one of the tied creatures during the upkeep ability's resolution. The choice isn't targeting. The other creature survives the turn; the spell does not allow regeneration of the destroyed one.
